modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
Kling 4.0 officially launches this October.

30s video. Up to 15 refs. 4K HDR. Better audio + lip sync.

6 wild examples + prompts.

Bookmark this ↓

originalPrompt: "Third-person chase shot from directly behind and slightly above a golden eagle as it flies over vast mountainous steppe. The camera follows at a fixed distance of a few metres, locked steady on the eagle, with smooth forward motion and no jitter. The whole bird stays in the lower centre of the frame with its full wingspan inside the frame and clear space on both sides. First it beats its wings powerfully, feathers flexing at the tips, then it spreads them wide and glides. Below and ahead, the landscape rushes toward the camera: winding rivers, open valleys, rocky peaks, with strong parallax. Bright late-afternoon sun from ahead, crisp air, a gentle rim light on its feathers, subtle lens flare. Realistic flight physics, motion blur from speed only, one continuous shot with no cuts."
